items.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
items.summary: Y Combinator Garry Tan has, in the past, jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, set to publish on Tuesday, Tan put a price tag on his passion.
items.creator: Julie Bort

items.title: Hinge tests a cheaper plan as users become more fed up paying for dating apps
items.summary: At a time when people are increasingly tired of dating apps, Hinge is testing a cheaper subscription plan.
items.creator: Lauren Forristal
